description: This Java class, AarResourceClassGenerator, dynamically generates Android R classes for resource repositories, especially for AAR libraries, to facilitate resource ID management and rendering in the Android Studio environment.

classes.name: AarResourceClassGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates Android R classes on the fly for resource repositories, used in rendering custom views in AAR libraries.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate AarResourceClassGenerator with application and AAR resource repositories.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates bytecode for a class representing resources, based on the fully qualified class name, handling styleable resources and default R class structure.
